title: Completed access configuration
statement: For a Boolean answer $b$ and natural numbers $k$ and $p$, take the configuration produced by the access procedure in its answer state with parameters $0,k,p$, then set its machine state to the halting state and its output tape to the one-symbol list $[b]$.
caveat: The definition of the underlying access configuration is not included, so its other fields cannot be described more explicitly.
